scope: Host-only USB bulk guard, XFlash read acceptance and offline preparation; no device test

read_correction.scope: Actual extracted read/DAloader/DaHandler/Main tail; setup/query/storage are modeled except dedicated command control

diagnostic_packaging: New packages bind the current transport inputs; existing archives and generated scripts need explicit refresh.
limits: Engineering USB budgets are not measured device compatibility; uncooperative backends are not preempted.
Raw control/exploit/discovery, other DA protocols, global status parsing, partition selection and physical media durability remain outside the read acceptance proof.
XFlash header datatypes and four-byte data/status distinction are unresolved; in-data frames of four bytes or less are rejected.
A missing packet-size query result stops the read; this deliberately removes the old 1MiB fallback and may reject a usable DA.
Published dumps require ordinary non-symlink paths and regular single-link destinations and use mode 0600; old inode/metadata are not retained.
Source checks and file publication assume a trusted single-owner host; no concurrent hostile-writer sandbox or power-loss durability is claimed.
